cases.title: Three-candidate accepted happy path
preconditions: The fixture and controlled setup for HP-01 are present in the hashed fixture manifest.
Scripted backend, CV, clock, and filesystem dependencies are deterministic, and scripted Accept cannot claim Tier C human evidence.
steps: Invoke tests/e2e/test_candidates.py::test_hp_01 with execution_actor=scripted_test.
Inject ROI drag, wait for three candidates, select card 1, send Space, allow publication, then send N through public GUI events.
Evaluate every oracle from structured state, ledgers, and hashes and write case_id=HP-01.
oracles: The event ledger exactly orders image_visible, ROI events, proposal/encode/candidates, selection, accept attempt/pass, commit, save, and next_image with strictly increasing sequence and monotonic time.

Exactly one encode produces three distinct compact cards; explicit scripted Accept commits the selected full mask; Next remains disabled until the versioned PNG and sidecar reload with matching hashes.
The sidecar records acceptance_actor=scripted_test, complete model/prompt/operation/policy provenance, and cannot count as Tier C human evidence.
